data.limits: 22 TAC §681.140(a)(1): 24 hours each renewal, including 6 ethics and 3 distinct-population competency. §681.140(a)(2): up to 10 excess hours may carry forward. §681.140(b)(2): jurisprudence exam may count 1 ethics hour.

data.providerPathway: 18VAC115-20-105 (the counselor renewal rule linked from the official Virginia code) should be applied to LPC; the retrieved neighboring Virginia behavioral-health rules show the relevant pattern of explicitly listing NBCC, but the exact counselor section was not captured. EduCare qualifies only if it is in fact an NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider, not merely NBCC-sponsored.

data.passage: Official Virginia code 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1): "Formally organized learning activities or home study. Activities may be counted at their full hour value." Its provider list includes "National Board for Certified Counselors." This is quoted as LMFT rule evidence only and is not cross-applied to LPC.

data.providerPathway: 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1)(d)(9) expressly lists the National Board for Certified Counselors among organizations whose certified/approved offerings qualify. Thus an actual NBCC Approved Continuing Education Provider such as EduCare ACEP8109 is supported on the stated provider pathway, subject to course relevance.
data.asyncRule: 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1) expressly permits "home study" at full hour value. 18VAC115-50-97(C)(1)(a) requires home-study documentation identifying source material, summary of content, and a signed completion affidavit; the rule does not expressly require a posttest or certificate for home study.
data.limits: 18VAC115-50-95(A): 20 hours annually, at least 2 ethics/laws. 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1): home study full hour value. 18VAC115-50-97: documentation requirements. No numeric home-study cap stated in the quoted provision.
data.passage: 18VAC115-50-95(A): "Marriage and family therapists shall be required to have completed a minimum of 20 hours of continuing competency for each annual licensure renewal. A minimum of two of these hours shall be in courses that emphasize the ethics, standards of practice, or laws governing behavioral science professions in Virginia." 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1): "Formally organized learning activities or home study. Activities may be counted at their full hour value." 18VAC115-50-96(B)(1)(d)(9): "National Board for Certified Counselors." 18VAC115-50-97(C)(1)(a): home-study documentation must identify source material, summarize content, and include a signed affidavit attesting completion.

data.providerPathway: 18VAC140-20-105(B)(1)(d) lists social-work-specific organizations (including NASW, ASWB, and any state social-work board), not NBCC. Therefore NBCC ACEP8109 alone is not an explicit provider pathway under the retrieved rule; additional qualifying approval would be needed.
data.asyncRule: 18VAC140-20-105(B)(2)(h) expressly permits individual/group study including viewing videotapes and reading professional books/articles, but the retrieved rule does not expressly say an NBCC asynchronous course with posttest/certificate qualifies as Category I formal learning.
data.limits: 18VAC140-20-105(A): LCSW minimum 30 contact hours; at least 6 ethics/standards/law. Category I minimum 20 hours; Category II maximum 10 hours. Individual/group study in Category II is capped at 5 hours.
data.passage: 18VAC140-20-105(A): "Licensed clinical social workers shall be required to have completed a minimum of 30 contact hours of continuing education" and six must pertain to ethics/standards/law. §105(B)(1): minimum 20 Category I hours. §105(B)(2): maximum 10 Category II hours; §105(B)(2)(h) includes "Individual or group study including listening to audio tapes, viewing video tapes, or reading professional books or articles" (maximum five hours).

data.providerPathway: WAC 246-809-610(3)(b) permits distance learning approved by an industry-recognized local, state, national, international organization or institution of higher learning. The rule does not expressly name NBCC, so EduCare ACEP8109 is conditional on NBCC being accepted as that organization for the course.
data.asyncRule: Explicit: WAC 246-809-610(3)(b) says distance-learning programs must require tests of comprehension upon completion; a posttest satisfies that stated feature. Certificate/documentation details are not in this section.
data.limits: WAC 246-809-630(3): 32 CE hours every two years; at least 6 ethics/law and at least 2 professional roles/boundaries, separate; 2 health-equity hours every 4 years; at least 6 suicide-assessment hours once every 6 years (count toward 32). No numeric distance-learning cap stated in WAC 246-809-610.
data.passage: WAC 246-809-610(3): 'Acceptable CE courses (including distance learning)... are those which are: ... (b) Distance learning programs, approved by an industry-recognized local, state, national or international organization or institution of higher learning. These programs must require tests of comprehension upon completion.' WAC 246-809-630(3): 'A licensed counselor shall complete 32 hours of continuing education (CE) every two years.'

data.providerPathway: WAC 246-809-610(3)(b) supplies the same conditional industry-recognized-organization pathway; it does not expressly name NBCC.

data.providerPathway: Wis. Admin. Code MPSW 19.03(1)(a) expressly approves programs approved/sponsored/provided/endorsed/authorized by NBCC.
data.asyncRule: MPSW 19.01(2) expressly defines interactive learning to include 'an asynchronous educational program' by a provider under MPSW 19.03(1)(a) or (f). Thus an NBCC-approved-provider asynchronous course is supported; posttest is not separately required by this rule.
data.limits: MPSW 19.02(1): at least 30 approved CE credit hours per 2-year credential period. MPSW 19.02(2): 4 ethics/boundaries hours; MPSW 19.05: retain certificates 4 years, certificate must include name, date, provider, hours, title. In-house non-approved cap 15/30 under MPSW 19.03(1)(f).
data.passage: MPSW 19.03(1)(a): 'Any continuing education program approved, sponsored, provided, endorsed, or authorized by... National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC).' MPSW 19.01(2): 'asynchronous educational program by a provider under s. MPSW 19.03 (1) (a) or (f).'

data.providerPathway: MPSW 19.03(1)(a) expressly lists NBCC-approved/sponsored/provided/endorsed/authorized programs for the board's covered professions, including marriage and family therapy.
data.asyncRule: MPSW 19.01(2) expressly includes an asynchronous educational program by a provider under MPSW 19.03(1)(a) or (f). Posttest is not separately required in the quoted rule.
data.limits: At least 30 approved hours per two-year credential period; 4 ethics/boundaries; retain sponsor certificates 4 years with name/date/provider/hours/title; non-approved in-house maximum 15 of 30.
data.passage: MPSW 19.03(1)(a): 'Any continuing education program approved... by... National Board for Certified Counselors (NBCC).' MPSW 19.01(2): 'an asynchronous educational program by a provider under s. MPSW 19.03 (1) (a) or (f).'

data.providerPathway: MPSW 19.03(1)(a) lists NBCC as an approved-program pathway, but MPSW 19.02(2)(b) requires social-work ethics hours in an interactive format; therefore general NBCC asynchronous CE is supported only subject to the social-work ethics restriction.
data.asyncRule: Asynchronous learning is expressly included in MPSW 19.01(2) when provided under MPSW 19.03(1)(a) or (f). Social-work ethics CE must be interactive under MPSW 19.02(2)(b).
data.limits: At least 30 hours per 2-year period; 4 ethics/boundaries hours, with social-work ethics in interactive format; retain certificates 4 years including name/date/provider/hours/title.
data.passage: MPSW 19.02(2)(b): 'Social work credential holders shall complete their ethics continuing education credit hours in an interactive learning format.' MPSW 19.01(2) expressly includes asynchronous programs by listed providers.
